skill_name: Give a description of a typical day in the life of a software developer
workflow: A software developer will typically start their day by attending team meetings and discussing any ongoing tasks and issues that need to be addressed. After the meeting, they will usually dive into the code to fix any outstanding errors or implement new features. As the day progresses, they might be involved in unit testing to ensure the quality of the code, as well as code reviews with other developers to ensure code accuracy.
